title: rayleigh-cert-mps/v1
description: Factorized Rayleigh certificate using MPS/MPO tensor storage.

assurance.description: reproducible: float64 MPS contraction.  rigorous: Arb/Acb transfer-matrix contractions.

rayleigh_upper.description: Stored upper bound (one ULP above computed Rayleigh quotient).

rayleigh_lower.description: Stored lower bound (one ULP below computed Rayleigh quotient).

input_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of domain-separated MPS/MPO tensor bytes.

mps_tensors.description: MPS site tensors encoded via _encode_canonical (present in to_full_dict output only).

mpo_tensors.description: MPO site tensors encoded via _encode_canonical (present in to_full_dict output only).
